title: Motor Konnect
cardDescription: Platform connecting vehicle owners with workshops and technicians — service booking, SOS assistance, spare parts and partner management.
overview: Motor Konnect connects vehicle owners with automotive services, workshops and technicians, offering service booking, workshop discovery, SOS assistance and spare-parts services.
problem: Vehicle owners find it hard to locate trusted workshops or get help quickly during a breakdown.
solution: A customer-facing platform to discover workshops, book services, request SOS help and browse service categories, with partner management on the business side.
result: Customers can find and book automotive services from one responsive platform, and workshops receive service requests digitally.
contributions: Built responsive website and app interfaces
Developed service booking and enquiry flows
Built workshop, technician and service displays

challenges.challenge: Making SOS help usable on a phone in stressful situations.
challenges.solution: Kept the SOS flow short, mobile-first and reachable in a single tap.
